<!--
Vaultic has a deliberately tight scope. Before filing, skim ROADMAP.md —
the feature might already be planned or already declined. We're friendly
about saying "no" or "not this shape"; that's not a rejection of you.
-->

## What you want to do

<!-- The user-facing problem. What are you trying to accomplish? -->

## Why the current tools don't cut it

<!--
What did you try? What's missing or awkward? "I want X" is fine; "I
tried X and it forced me into Y" is more useful.
-->

## Sketch of the change

<!--
What you imagine it looking like. A new command? A new flag on an
existing one? A daemon protocol method? Don't worry about getting this
right — it's a starting point for the conversation.
-->

```
$ vaultic <something>
```

## Scope check

<!--
Does this change:
  - the on-disk vault format?
  - the agent wire protocol?
  - cryptographic primitives or parameters?
  - require a new dependency?

If yes to any, say so explicitly — those have a higher bar.
-->
